CustomField.label: Failure Severity
CustomField.description: The business-impact level shown only when this check results in Fail: "Critical" shows red, "Warning" shows amber, "Info" shows blue. It has no effect on Pass, Skipped, Unable to Evaluate, or system-error outcomes. Defaults to "Warning". Severity is deliberately separate from the engine's system-error status, which is why there is no "Error" choice.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sets the color/level when the check fails: "Critical" = red, "Warning" = amber (default), "Info" = blue. No effect on non-fail outcomes.
